subject: Post-discovery: 30-min demo for FinCredit — next steps
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@fincredit.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: 30-min demo for FinCredit — next steps

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through FinCredit's use case. Quick recap from our side:
- Goal: reduce model latency for fraud scoring at peak traffic while keeping per-token costs predictable; primary traffic is transactional fraud detection with 100k p50/sec spikes.
- Requirements: sub-200ms tail latency for scoring, support for on-prem/private deployment for sensitive data, and SOC 2-compatible audit logging.
- Key stakeholders identified: you (Product), Kevin (Technical Lead), and your Security team for compliance specifics.

Next step: we'd love to run a 30-minute demo/technical intro to show the runtime, latency profiles, and a sketch of rollout options. Proposed slots (all PT):
1) Mon, Feb 16 — 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Tue, Feb 17 — 11:00–11:30 PT
3) Tue, Feb 17 — 14:00–14:30 PT

If you can confirm which slot works and which stakeholders will join (we suggest Product + Tech Lead + any Security representative), I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda. Jordan (cc) will lead the technical portion; Marissa (cc) will cover onboarding and timelines.

Attaching the discovery notes and a short product one-pager for context.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf, product-specs.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://www.redwoodinference.com
